source: NJ Transit; Borough of Mountain Lakes; National Park Service (Nov. 2026)

slides.sub: Plus 2 more stops, all a short walk apart. Swipe for what they are and where to find them.
slides.source: NJ Transit; Borough of Mountain Lakes; National Park Service (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Mountain Lakes Station
slides.body: Built by the Lackawanna railroad in 1912. NJ Transit trains still stop here on weekdays.
slides.source: NJ Transit; NJ Historic Trust; Wikipedia (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Mountain Lakes Public Library
slides.body: The town library is a short walk from the station lots. It has a makerspace and an events calendar.

slides.title: Mountain Lakes Historic District
slides.body: Woods in 1910, a planned town about 10 years later. 451 Hapgood homes still stand.
slides.source: NPS NRIS 05000963; Borough of Mountain Lakes (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: 3 stops, one town
slides.tip: Non-residents pay $100 a year to park at the station. Evenings and weekends: 3 hours, no permit.
slides.source: NJ Transit, Mountain Lakes station page (Nov. 2026)
